mutations.name: horns
mutations.desc: You have a pair of horns on your head.

mutations.desc: You reflexively headbutt those who attack you in melee.

inventory.description: A military axe with a long haft and a single-bladed head.

inventory.description: A small piece of wood and metal, to be strapped on one arm for defence.

inventory.name: 2 potions of might
inventory.description: A potion which greatly increases the power of the drinker's melee attacks.
